title: armeria maritima var. trachyphylla
intro: Armeria maritima var. trachyphylla, commonly known as sea thrift, is a variety of flowering plant in the family Plumbaginaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may aid in wound healing and reducing the severity of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Armeria maritima var. trachyphylla include expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a popular choice for treating respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties are flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, including sesquiterpene lactones and phenylpropanoids.
